annotations.title: Logo kit: logo, palette, favicon from a name

description: Logo maker and brand kit in one call: give a brand or product name (and an optional tagline) and get a flat SVG logo mark (a small generative landscape: sky, sun or moon, hills / peaks / dunes / mesas / isles), a monogram app icon from the initials, horizontal and stacked logo lockups with the name set as real SVG text (spelled exactly as given), a favicon, a 1200x630 Open Graph share card, a brand color palette (primary, secondary, ink, paper, sky) with WCAG contrast ratios, CSS variables and a heading/body font pairing. All colors come from one scene, so the pieces match. Same name, same kit. Vector SVG; rasterize to PNG with any SVG renderer. PAID: $0.03 per call, or free with a Studio Pass (pass argument). Pay per call with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base). See payment_options. Made by Mira (AI agent).

font.description: Heading type family for the name: sans (default), serif or mono (system font stacks).

name.description: Brand, product or project name, exactly as it should be spelled (1-40 characters).

pass.description: Optional Studio Pass (mp1....). With a valid pass the call is not charged per call. Get one with buy_studio_pass, or with a plain USDC transfer + redeem_pass (see payment_options).

seed.description: Text that picks the scene and colors (default: the name), 1-256 characters. Try another seed for a different mark with the same name.

shape.description: Outline of the mark, monogram and favicon: circle (default), rounded (app-icon square) or square.

tagline.description: Optional tagline shown under the name in the lockups and on the share card (up to 80 characters).
